title: Tomb Raiders
native_title: トゥーム・レイダース
overview:
Ancient treasures sleeping in ruins. Deadly traps that stop intruders... Drawn by the allure of the ruins, adventurer Lara Croft set off for the Inca lands. What awaits her there!?

The huge ancient ruins, rendered in full polygons, are as natural and three-dimensional as the real world! The 3D character, dashing all over the vast ruins, can perform a wide variety of actions - not just running and jumping, but swimming, climbing, hanging from cliffs and more! Huge traps blocking your path, countless baffling puzzles, and enemies, enemies, enemies attacking without mercy! Use your head, hone your skills, and seize the ancient treasures sleeping in the ruins with your own hands!!

遺跡に眠る古代の秘宝。侵入者を阻む危険な罠・・・。冒険家レイラ・クロフトは遺跡の魅力に導かれ、インカへと旅立った。そこに待ち受けるものは!?

フルポリゴンで描かれた巨大な古代遺跡は現実の世界と同様に自然かつ立体的!広大な遺跡の中を所狭しと駆け巡る3Dのキャラクターは、走る、跳ぶはもちろん、泳ぐ、登る、崖につかまるなど多彩なアクションが可能!行く手を阻む巨大な罠、難解な謎の数々、容赦無く襲い掛かる敵、敵、敵!頭を使い、腕を磨き、遺跡に眠る古代の秘宝をその手でつかみ取れ!!
